The number of instructions retired from execution. This count includes exceptions and interrupts. Each exception or interrupt is counted as one instruction.
Count all the Instruction cache fill requests that misses in L2 cache.
The ITLB reloads originating from page table walker. The table walk requests are made for L1-ITLB Miss and L2-ITLB Misses.
The number of instruction fetches that hit in the L1 ITLB.

IC Tag All Instruction Cache Access

column3: The average number of CPU cycles consumed to retire an instruction. This metric is computed as the ratio of CYCLES_NOT_IN_HALT to RETIRED_INST event. The higher values means the application consumes more CPU cycles to retire an instruction due to high cache misses, branch mispredictions, pipeline stalls, I/O or any other bottlenecks. If the CPI values exceeds a threshold value, it will be highlighted in pink.
The number of L1 instruction cache misses, per thousand retired instructions.
The number of L2 cache access requests due to L1 instruction cache misses, per thousand retired instructions. This L2 cache access requests also includes the prefetches.
The number of L2 cache misses from L1 Instruction cache misses, per thousand retired instructions.
The number of L1 ITLB Requests, per thousand retired instructions.
The number of L1 ITLB Misses, per thousand retired instructions.
The number of L2 ITLB Misses, per thousand retired instructions.
The ITLB L1 Miss rate is the number of ITLB L1_Miss_L2_Hits and L1_Miss_L2_Miss divided by the total number of retired instructions.
The ITLB L2 Miss rate is the number of ITLB L2 Miss divided by the total number of retired instructions.
